neet_phy_u16_t01_1.working: Frequency does not change on refraction. Wavelength in glass = 600/1.5 = 400 nm.

neet_phy_u16_t01_2.working: Each layer contributes thickness/n. Water: 12/(4/3) = 9 cm. Liquid: 9/1.5 = 6 cm. Total apparent depth = 15 cm.

neet_phy_u16_t01_5.working: A true: speed and wavelength both drop by a factor of n. B false: normal shift t(1 - 1/n) does not depend on object distance. C true: parallel faces give lateral displacement with no deviation. D true: the fish sees the object n times farther. E false: R is positive when the centre of curvature is on the refracted-light side.
